description: A man with a receding dark hairline and a dark coat with a high white collar presses one eye to a silver-and-brass lantern that holds a lit candle. A slender metal tube extends from the lantern toward the lower left. Behind him are old leather-bound books and glass flasks on a wooden table, in a dim, dark-brown room. The painting is oil-like, fills the whole square, and has no visible text or border.
